goals.name: Transform Demo Preparation Through Automation & Standardisation

smartGoal.statement: By 2026-12-31, reduce total demo preparation hours by automating environment provisioning and standardising demo assets, resulting in faster readiness and reduced manual effort.

objectives: Deploy automated demo environment provisioning
Standardise core demo blueprints by product and use case
Centralise ownership of demo environments
Reduce rep-managed demo systems

achievable.resources: Automation tooling, platform engineering, demo platform budget
achievable.ownership: Demo Ops owns automation, IT owns infrastructure, Product defines standards

timeline.deliverable: Target demo automation architecture and standards
Automated provisioning MVP
Standard demos live for priority products
Prep hour reduction fully realised

goals.name: Increase Revenue-Facing Demo Capacity & Presentation Time

smartGoal.statement: By 2026-12-31, increase customer-facing demo presentation hours by reallocating time saved from prep automation, resulting in higher sales capacity and deal coverage.

objectives: Reallocate prep time savings to presentation capacity
Improve prep-to-present ratio
Increase supported deal coverage
Expand demo availability for peak sales periods

achievable.resources: Automation gains, scheduling tools, capacity planning
achievable.ownership: Demo Ops manages capacity, Sales aligns demand

timeline.deliverable: New capacity model approved
Prep savings redirected to demos
Expanded demo coverage live
Target presentation hours achieved

goals.name: Establish Demo as a Scalable Revenue & Lead Generation Channel

smartGoal.statement: By 2026-12-31, launch self-service demo experiences and Tiled.io-powered microsites to generate qualified leads and enable personalised sales engagement, resulting in increased top-of-funnel pipeline and higher seller productivity.

objectives: Deploy Tiled.io as standard demo microsite platform
Deploy self-service demo experiences
Create reusable microsite templates by product and persona
Integrate demo with marketing lead capture and CRM
Enable personalised demo journeys for strategic accounts

achievable.resources: Tiled.io licenses, self-service demo platform, marketing integration, enablement content, integration engineering
achievable.ownership: Demo owns platform and templates, Marketing owns lead flow, Sales owns follow-up, Sales Enablement drives adoption

timeline.deliverable: Tiled.io configured and self-service platform chosen
Core microsite templates and initial self-service demos live
Sales teams enabled, persona-based journeys deployed
Account-level personalisation and lead/pipeline targets achieved

goals.name: Deliver Executive-Level Transparency, Demo Intelligence & Experience Quality (NPS)

smartGoal.statement: By 2026-12-31, implement an executive demo intelligence platform with NPS and feedback tracking, resulting in improved demo quality, accountability, and revenue alignment.

objectives: Launch executive demo operations dashboard
Implement demo NPS collection
Capture qualitative demo feedback
Establish monthly exec reporting cadence

metrics: Demo NPS baseline established: No → Yes

achievable.resources: BI tooling, survey platform, RevOps analytics support
achievable.ownership: RevOps owns dashboard, Demo owns NPS and feedback

timeline.deliverable: Executive metrics framework
Live executive dashboard
NPS live for all demos
Closed-loop improvement process

goals.name: Build an Integrated Demo Data & Technology Ecosystem with ROI Attribution

smartGoal.statement: By 2026-12-31, integrate demo platforms with CRM and financial systems to enable end-to-end demo-to-revenue tracking and ROI reporting, resulting in clear accountability and investment justification.

objectives: Integrate demo platform with CRM
Define standard demo influence and attribution model
Enable demo-to-opportunity attribution
Implement demo ROI and cost-to-serve reporting
Centralise demo analytics
Publish quarterly demo revenue impact reports

achievable.resources: CRM integration, BI tooling, RevOps analytics support, data platform, financial tracking tools
achievable.ownership: RevOps owns attribution model and data model, IT builds integrations, Demo owns activity tracking, Finance validates ROI

timeline.deliverable: Standard demo attribution framework and integration architecture
Demo activity linked to opportunities, CRM and demo platform connected
Demo-to-revenue attribution live, Demo ROI dashboards built
Full ecosystem reporting, Quarterly exec ROI reporting cadence

goals.name: Establish Demo Asset Governance & Data Verification

smartGoal.statement: By 2026-12-31, establish a governed, verified inventory of all demo assets and data, resulting in improved accuracy, reduced risk, and higher demo reliability.

objectives: Create a central demo asset inventory and registry
Implement regular demo data verification and audits
Define ownership and lifecycle management for demo assets
Retire outdated or duplicate demo environments and assets

achievable.resources: Asset management tooling, audit processes, product data owners
achievable.ownership: Demo owns registry, Product owns data accuracy, IT supports tooling

timeline.deliverable: Complete demo asset inventory
Ownership and lifecycle model defined
Automated verification and audits live
High-confidence demo asset baseline

goals.name: Standardise Demo Narrative, Storytelling & Value Messaging Excellence

smartGoal.statement: By 2026-12-31, standardise persona-based demo narratives and value messaging to improve buyer relevance and deal conversion, resulting in higher-quality and more consistent demo experiences.

objectives: Define persona-based demo story frameworks
Create outcome-driven demo flows
Embed value and ROI messaging into demos
Standardise demo narrative playbooks

achievable.resources: Product marketing content, enablement resources, demo design capacity
achievable.ownership: Product Marketing owns messaging, Demo owns flows, Enablement drives rollout

timeline.deliverable: Persona and value story frameworks
Standard demo flows created
Playbooks and training delivered
Story-driven demo quality targets met

goals.name: Enable Strategic Demo Localization & Multi-Lingual Assets

smartGoal.statement: By 2026-12-31, localize priority demo assets and narratives into strategic languages to support regional growth, resulting in improved buyer engagement and global deal conversion.

objectives: Identify priority regions and languages
Localize core demo narratives and assets
Implement multilingual demo data and UI support
Enable regional ownership of localized demos

achievable.resources: Localization vendors, regional SMEs, demo platform support
achievable.ownership: Demo owns assets, Product Marketing owns translation, Regions own validation

timeline.deliverable: Target regions and languages approved
Top demos localized
Multilingual demo support live
Localized demos operational globally

smartGoal.statement: By 2027-12-31, evolve and mature the existing Demo Services operating model to improve clarity, efficiency, visibility, and consistency in support, decisioning, and engagement across all products, platforms, and regions.

objectives: Design clear visual flow diagrams for support decisioning
Refresh team ownership maps and contact lists
Reinforce mandatory ticketing for all demo engagements
Surface operational flows and ownership in the platform

metrics: Repeat issues due to misrouting: Baseline → -50%

achievable.resources: Process design expertise, platform engineering, knowledge management tools
achievable.ownership: Demo Ops owns process design, IT supports platform integration, Leadership enforces adoption

timeline.deliverable: Visual flow diagrams and standard paths for support decisioning
Updated ownership maps and contact lists aligned to org structure
Mandatory ticketing embedded in operational workflows
Operational flows and support models visible in Executive Summary Platform

lagging.name: Time to route to correct team

smartGoal.statement: By Dec 31, 2026, reduce demo prep hours for strategic products by 40%; onboard 10 strategic products with Copilot tailored to demo intelligence; implement rapid provisioning for priority portfolios; establish verified asset baselines and retire outdated assets; measure and track time-to-demo improvements.

objectives: Reduce prep hours by 40% for strategic products
Onboard 10 strategic products with Copilot demo intelligence
Implement rapid demo provisioning for priority portfolios
Establish verified asset inventory and governance framework
Measure time-to-demo reduction and establish baseline
Retire outdated assets from strategic portfolios

metrics: Verified asset baseline established: No → Yes

achievable.resources: AI tooling, automation platform, governance framework, asset management system
achievable.ownership: Demo Services owns automation, RevOps defines governance, Commercial Office sponsors

timeline.deliverable: Baseline metrics and governance framework defined
First 5 products with Copilot demo intelligence
Rapid provisioning live for priority portfolios
40% prep hour reduction achieved, asset governance live

smartGoal.statement: By Dec 31, 2026, increase customer-facing hours by 15% through automation; improve prep-to-present efficiency for strategic products; expand deal support capacity; establish demo-led win rate baselines; implement NPS feedback collection and measure satisfaction improvements.

objectives: Increase customer-facing hours by 15%
Improve prep-to-present ratio for strategic products
Expand support to priority deals across businesses
Establish demo-led win rate baseline and track improvements
Implement NPS feedback collection across all demos
Collect measurable satisfaction data and identify improvement areas

metrics: Satisfaction score baseline: none → tracked quarterly

achievable.resources: Automation savings, NPS tooling, CRM integration, feedback platform
achievable.ownership: Demo Services manages capacity, RevOps tracks metrics, Commercial Office sponsors

timeline.deliverable: NPS platform deployed, baseline metrics captured
Automation savings redirected to customer-facing time
Priority deal coverage expanded, win rate tracking live
15% customer-facing hour increase achieved

goals.name: Build a Demo-Led Digital Pipeline Engine

smartGoal.statement: By Dec 31, 2026, launch 10 self-service demos for strategic products; deploy Tiled microsites for priority portfolios; establish digital pipeline tracking; measure lead generation, demo requests, and conversion metrics; enable seller adoption and track usage data.

objectives: Launch 10 self-service demos for strategic products
Deploy 15-20 Tiled microsites for priority products
Establish lead generation and demo request tracking
Measure pipeline influence and establish attribution baselines
Track seller adoption metrics for priority portfolios
Integration Demo engagement cycle to StoreFront for 2-3 products

achievable.resources: Tiled platform, self-service demo technology, CRM integration, analytics tools
achievable.ownership: Demo Services builds experiences, Marketing drives adoption, RevOps measures impact

timeline.deliverable: Tiled platform configured, first 3 self-service demos live
10 microsites live, 7 self-service demos operational
StoreFront integrations live, attribution tracking enabled
20 microsites, pipeline influence measured quarterly

goals.name: Deliver Executive Demo Intelligence & ROI Attribution

smartGoal.statement: By Dec 31, 2026, deliver executive demo dashboard with quarterly reporting; implement NPS/feedback instrumentation; establish CRM integration for demo-to-opportunity attribution; build cost-per-demo tracking; automate reporting workflows and reduce manual effort.

objectives: Launch executive demo dashboard with key metrics
Deliver quarterly executive reports (4 in 2026)
Establish CRM integration for strategic products
Implement demo-to-opportunity attribution tracking
Build cost-per-demo visibility framework
Reduce manual reporting effort by 50%+

metrics: Executive dashboard: Not live → Live Q2

achievable.resources: BI platform, CRM integration tools, automation workflows, cost allocation framework
achievable.ownership: RevOps builds reporting, Demo Services provides data, Finance validates costs

timeline.deliverable: Executive dashboard MVP live, Q1 report delivered
CRM integration live, Q2 report delivered
Demo-to-opportunity attribution tracked, Q3 report
Automated reporting live, Q4 report, 50% effort reduction

smartGoal.statement: By Dec 31, 2026, localize high-impact demos for 3-4 priority regions; publish localized assets; establish regional adoption tracking; measure regional performance and identify improvement opportunities.

objectives: Deliver localized demos for 3-4 strategic regions/languages
Publish 20-30 localized assets for Banking & Capital Markets
Establish regional adoption tracking and baselines
Measure regional win rate performance for demo-led deals
Focus 75%+ of localized content on strategic portfolios
Collect feedback and refine localization approach

achievable.resources: Localization platform, translation services, regional SMEs, content management system
achievable.ownership: Demo Services delivers content, Product Marketing defines requirements, RevOps tracks performance

croAlignment: Redefine market leadership in Banking & Capital Markets

timeline.deliverable: 4 priority regions identified, localization plan approved
First 2 regions live with 10 assets each
3-4 regions live, 25 total assets published
30 assets live, regional performance tracked, feedback incorporated
